headline_marked: Govt [[buying Chinese J-10CE fighter jets]] for Air Force modernization
headline: Govt buying Chinese J-10CE fighter jets for Air Force modernization
summary: Draft contracts are ready for the acquisition of multi-role fighter aircraft and attack helicopters to upgrade the Bangladesh Air Force.
details: The Bangladesh government is moving forward with the purchase of Chinese-made J-10CE fighter jets for the Bangladesh Air Force. Information and Broadcasting Advisor Zahed Ur Rahman announced this during a regular press conference at the Secretariat on Tuesday.

As part of the modernization of the Air Force, the government is in the process of acquiring various models of fourth-generation MRCA fighter aircraft, attack helicopters, VIP helicopters, and UAV systems.

Draft contracts for the procurement of the MRCA (J-10CE) and attack helicopters have been prepared by the relevant committee through negotiation meetings and have been sent to the Armed Forces Division and other ministries for approval.

Advisor Zahed Ur Rahman highlighted the capabilities of the J-10CE, claiming it had performed well in combat situations against the Rafale, which he described as one of the most modern 4.5 generation fighters.

The Advisor also noted that Chinese fighters are significantly more affordable than European variants of similar quality, such as the Rafale or Eurofighter Typhoon, ensuring national defense while managing costs.
caption:

topic: tib condemns state minister citizenship response
headline_marked: TIB: [[State minister's response to citizenship query]] echoes ousted regime
headline: TIB: State minister's response to citizenship query echoes ousted regime
summary: Transparency International Bangladesh has urged the government to disclose the citizenship status of State Minister Humaiun Kobir, citing potential constitutional conflicts.
details: Transparency International Bangladesh (TIB) has urged the government to disclose verifiable information regarding the citizenship status of State Minister for Foreign Affairs Humaiun Kobir.
TIB warns that his appointment under the technocrat quota would be unconstitutional if he held foreign citizenship upon assuming office, citing Articles 56(2) and 66(2)(c) of the Constitution.
The anti-graft watchdog criticized the state minister for responding to journalists' questions about dual citizenship with counter-questions rather than direct answers.
TIB Executive Director Iftekharuzzaman stated that the minister's 'resentful and aggressive' approach reflects a 'shoot the messenger' mentality associated with the ousted authoritarian regime.
The organization expressed concern that such conduct could pressure journalists and lead to self-censorship, undermining the public's right to know.
TIB has called for the immediate disclosure of citizenship documents for any minister or state minister if questions about dual citizenship arise to ensure transparency.
caption:
Is the State Minister for Foreign Affairs' appointment unconstitutional? TIB demands clarity on his citizenship status.

Transparency International Bangladesh (TIB) has urged the government to disclose verifiable information regarding the citizenship status of State Minister for Foreign Affairs Humaiun Kobir.

TIB warns that his appointment under the technocrat quota would be unconstitutional if he held foreign citizenship upon assuming office, citing Articles 56(2) and 66(2)(c) of the Constitution.

The anti-graft watchdog criticized the state minister for responding to journalists' questions about dual citizenship with counter-questions rather than direct answers.

TIB Executive Director Iftekharuzzaman stated that the minister's 'resentful and aggressive' approach reflects a 'shoot the messenger' mentality associated with the ousted authoritarian regime.

The organization expressed concern that such conduct could pressure journalists and lead to self-censorship, undermining the public's right to know.

TIB has called for the immediate disclosure of citizenship documents for any minister or state minister if questions about dual citizenship arise to ensure transparency.

#Bangladesh #TIB #Transparency #Governance #Politics #Accountability

Source: The Daily Star, Jamuna TV, Dhaka Tribune, Prothom Alo
